N718 replaces N713 individually calibrated geometric response with unknown heterogeneous gains under a justified microscopic product law, repeatable possibly nonstationary preparation, and either within-label neutrality or all-event activity access. Product settings are not sequential pulses. Nonstationary completion and gain-overlap certificates are source-reported extensions; source-clock ambiguity and access acquisition remain load-bearing. This does not establish arbitrary observed-only identification, validate a physical actuator or promote N713 correctness/priority; its history and gates are retained.

N736 extends stationary/calibrated closure-response navigation to a bounded-rate frozen-history predictor on the deployed controller occupation law. It reconstructs acquisition under actual intervention products, changes the certification target to whole visible paths and retains finite/noisy costs. It neither upgrades N713 nor removes its kinetic-access obstructions; no theorem dependency or invalidation is inferred.
